name: Idea
about: Thinking out loud - half-formed is fine
title: "[IDEA]"
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**What are you thinking about?**
Half-formed is fine.  "Has anyone considered", "what should a clock even
show", an argument about what belongs on the screen - all of it belongs
here.  It does not have to be a thing you want built, or a thing you are
offering to build.

**What made you think of it?**
The clock you have, something another project does, something that annoyed
you at 3am.  Whatever the reason is - it is usually the useful part.

**Anything to look at?**
A screenshot, a link, a config, a map style you made.  Nothing required.
